title: "Benchmark catalogue"

```{r}
#| echo: false
capsule <- "results/reference/01_finemapping/separated-development-v1"
manifest <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(capsule, "benchmark_manifest.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
```

## Available benchmarks

### [Separated-locus fine-mapping development pilot](01_finemapping/separated-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Development benchmark |
| Study type | Separated-locus, scalar-trait fine-mapping |
| Methods | `r paste(manifest$methods, collapse = ", ")` |
| Replicates | `r manifest$replicate_count` |
| Data limitation | Example markers have limited LD; genotype data are not redistributed |
| Capsule | [Benchmark reproducibility capsule](../results/reference/01_finemapping/separated-development-v1/README.md) |

## Planned benchmarks

- Separated-locus benchmark with realistic LD.
- High-LD causal architecture.
- Scientific-length MCMC calibration.
- Prediction study.
- Multi-trait study.
- Annotation-informed models.
- Block-eigen methods.

Planned benchmarks are not yet completed or published.
